extraction_notes: The paper contains many multi-series line plots (Figures 4a,b; 5a,b; 6; 7; 8; 9a,d). Exact numerical values are printed only for selected entries in the text/Table 1. I extracted all exact this-work values from Table 1 and the text, and approximate values only for the clearest flow-rate and impurity-dependence plotted points where catalyst and condition were unambiguous. Literature-comparison rows in Table 1 bearing external references were excluded. Pure Fe, CeO2, Sm2O3, SDC, ZrO2, Y2O3 and YSZ blank/support-only tests with no observed ammonia were excluded.
